description:
YITAMOTOR floor mats completely line the interior carpet to provide all-encompassing protection. We are confident that our products will surpass your expectations and make you a happy customer!
Fitment
2008-2020 Dodge Grand Caravan
2008-2016 Chrysler Town & Country Stow'n Go (2nd Row Bucket Seating)
7 Seats Models
Only Fits 1st row with Super Console & 2nd Row Bucket Seating
Does not fit vehicles with vinyl flooring,only fit for carpet flooring.
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Features
Custom Fit: These floor mats are compatible with 2008-2020 Dodge Grand Caravan Bucket Seating, fit for 2008-2016 Chrysler Town & Country Van Stow'n Go (2nd Row Bucket Seating) 7-Seater, 3D laser scanning technology giving the front and back fully protection. Not for vehicles with vinyl floors, Please take out old floor mats before installing new floor liners
Built For Durability: YITAMOTOR floor liners are made from TPE material featuring high tensity for great comfort and wear-resistance while remaining flexible and user-friendly even in extreme cold or hot environments; Product contains no latex, cadmium, lead, or any harmful PVC
All Season Protection & Non-Slip: Uniquely designed channels and raised edge can effectively trap debris, snow, mud, and sand to keep your car and shoes clean; Built-in retainer clips to firmly grip the mat and prevent slipping when wet
Easy To Clean: The textured skid-resistant surface is easily cleaned, No need the cumbersome vacuum cleaner or harsh chemicals, Simply shake them out or spray them down with a hose
Why Choose Yitamotor: Our floor mats are processed with advanced technology, rendering tailored protection and all-weather guard to your vehicle
highlights: They securely attach to your vehicle using the original factory clasps, keeping the floor liners firmly in place and preventing unwanted shifting during daily driving.
The raised edges provide maximum vehicle coverage, Floor Liners accurately and completely line the vehicle carpet giving absolute interior protection.
Specially designed channels ensure the liner effectively contain the liquid to keep your vehicle and shoes clean, non-slip design for safe driving.

specifications.Special features: Solid, easy to install, easy to clean, precision 3d laser measured, perfect fit, waterproof, anti-slip, durable, non-toxic tpe material, all-weather protection
